title: Hip fracture to SNF; choice documented but no provider list, no quality data, medication changes not explained

rationale.pac_list: Freedom of choice is documented, but nothing shows the patient was given a list of available Medicare-participating SNFs.
rationale.pac_choice: The note documents freedom to choose and that the referral went to the facility the patient and daughter selected; the missing list is scored under pac_list.
rationale.pac_quality_data: No quality or resource-use data (for example Care Compare ratings) is documented.
rationale.med_changes: Enoxaparin, oxycodone, senna and cholecalciferol are new, but there is no medication changes section and no statement of what was started, stopped or changed versus home medications; only the hospital course mentions that vitamin D supplementation was begun (hence unclear is also acceptable).
rationale.dp_evaluation: The case management note documents a discharge planning assessment with post-hospital needs.
